Boboli Pineapple Pizza
By: Matt Randall
Published: Tuesday, November 9, 2010 - 7:24pm

Ingredients




1 • BOBOLI PIZZA CRUST
1 package • very thinly sliced ham (6- 8 oz.)
1 can • (8 oz.) pineapple slices
1/2 cup • chopped green pepper
1 package • (8 oz.) shredded mozzarella cheese

Preparation

1 Layer chopped ham, halved pineapple slices, chopped green pepper, and mozzarella on top of Boboli. 2 Bake 10 minutes in a 425 degree oven until cheese is melted and pineapple is hot.
